name: ACDSee Photo Studio
price: Mac 27: $119.99 one-time (presale $99.95 to 2026-11-18); Mac App Store: annual subscription; Windows Home/Professional/Ultimate 2027 one-time or ACDSee 365 subscription
engine: Own decoders; Windows video via system codecs, Mac video via Quick Look
summary: Long-standing photo DAM and RAW editor that works on existing folders without import: catalog database, ratings, keywords, AI faces and keywords, non-destructive Develop mode and batch tools. The Windows editions also play common videos and browse ZIP/RAR archives; the Mac edition is more limited there. Paid, aimed at photographers who manage and edit.
where_it_wins: Full DAM: ratings, keywords, categories, faces, AI keywords and image similarity
Non-destructive RAW editing with AI masking
Windows: ZIP/RAR browsing and video metadata
where_schnellbild_wins: Free, open source, no account or activation
Plays MKV, WebM, AVI, FLV with subtitles and audio tracks on the Mac
7z, RAR5, CBZ/CBR and passworded archives as folders
Dual pane with F5/F6 and undo
Lean viewer, no database to maintain
